title: The effect of statins on testosterone in men and women, a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
authors: Schooling CM, Au Yeung SL, Freeman G, Cowling BJ
population: 11 placebo-controlled randomised trials: 5 in 501 mainly middle-aged men with hypercholesterolaemia and 6 in 368 young women with polycystic ovary syndrome
authorConflicts: One author has received research funding from MedImmune Inc. and consults for Crucell MV.
result: Statins lowered testosterone by 0.66 nmol/L (95% CI 0.14 to 1.18) in men and by 0.40 nmol/L (0.05 to 0.75) in women with polycystic ovary syndrome; overall by 0.44 nmol/L (0.13 to 0.75). Most included trials were carried out by teams affiliated with or funded by pharmaceutical companies. The authors state that whether this is a detrimental side effect or a mode of action warrants investigation.
